# Bereg DS

> Open-source design system by Konstantin Beregovoy, the "Engineering Blueprint" style of bereg.dev. Figma library, DTCG design tokens, a CSS core and React components, published on npm as `bereg-ds` under the MIT license.

Install: `npm i bereg-ds`. Import `bereg-ds/bereg-ds.css` for fonts, tokens, base styles and components; import React components from `bereg-ds/react` (React is optional). Plain HTML works with the same classes, for example `<a class="btn btn-primary" href="/projects/">Projects</a>`.

Rules:
- Strict 4px scale: spacing, gaps and radii are multiples of 4 (`--space-1` = 4px ... `--space-16` = 64px).
- Tokens only: components never use raw colors or pixel spacing; a test enforces it.
- Units: font sizes and spacing in rem, line height without units, letter spacing in em, strokes in px, breakpoints in em.
- Accessibility: text contrast at least 7:1 (WCAG AAA for contrast), interactive borders at least 3:1, a visible focus ring on every interactive component, underlined links.
- Dark theme only for now. HDR is an optional accent, never a default.
- Fonts: IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono, self-hosted through Fontsource.

Components: Button, Link, Nav Link, Tag, Card, Quote, Filter Tabs, Book Promo, Section, Facts, Timeline, Post List, Site Header, Site Footer.

## Docs

- [Storybook documentation](https://ds.bereg.dev/): rules, colors, typography, spacing, HDR, all components and a full page built from components.
- [README](https://github.com/KonstantinBeregovoy/bereg-ds/blob/main/README.md): install and usage.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/KonstantinBeregovoy/bereg-ds/blob/main/SKILL.md): instructions for AI agents that build UI with Bereg DS.
